ruleDefinitions.name: Insecure Proxy/DOH Transfer Via Curl.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "curl.exe" with the "insecure" flag over proxy or DOH.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\curl\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "curl\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-doh\\-insecure.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-proxy\\-insecure.*")))
